hist.stayedSwap: Stayed in place when {{serial}} was swapped

eq.parentHint: A new parent moves this equipment (and its children) to the parent's location. Clear it to detach, keeping the current location.
eq.duplicateSerial: Saved. Note: another record already has this serial number.
eq.moveDesc: The equipment takes the location of the new parent.
eq.swapDesc: The two equipment exchange places: parent, location and status (the status goes with the place).
eq.detachDesc: Detach from {{serial}}. The equipment stays at {{location}}.
eq.parentCreateHint: Pick one if this equipment is mounted in another — its location follows the parent.
eq.locationFromParent: Follows the parent — clear Parent equipment to set a location of its own.
eq.levelFromParent: Follows the parent — clear Parent equipment to set a level of its own.
eq.typeFromPartNumber: Follows the part number — admins set it in Configuration › Part Number.
eq.parentFixed: Adding a child of {{serial}} — fixed here. To use another parent, save first, then Move.
eq.childrenQuestion: What happens to the child equipment?
eq.chooseChildren: Choose whether they go along or stay in place.
eq.followLocation: The whole branch of {{serial}} moves to the new location.
eq.followParent: The whole branch moves with {{serial}} and takes the new parent's location.
eq.followDetach: The whole branch is detached together with {{serial}}.
eq.stayUnder: Children keep location {{location}} and are attached to {{serial}}.
eq.stayAlone: Children keep location {{location}} and stand alone (no parent).
eq.swapFollowHint: Each equipment takes its whole branch along.
eq.swapStayHint: Only the two equipment change places; children keep their place and attach to the newcomer: {{moves}}.
eq.swapNoChange: Both have the same parent and location, so swapping changes nothing.
eq.swapNoChangeKids: Both have the same parent and location: swapping whole branches changes nothing. Choose "Stay in place" to exchange their children.
eq.deleteDesc: Permanent — cannot be undone. History is kept.
eq.deleteFollowHint: Deletes {{serial}} and all {{count}} equipment below it.

imp.title: Import equipment from Excel
imp.step1Desc: The template has drop-down lists for Part number, Type, Level, Status and Location, taken from Configuration at download time. Its first row says what each column accepts. Download it again after Configuration changes.
imp.step2Desc: .xlsx only, up to {{max}} rows per import. The file is checked first — nothing is added until you press Import.
imp.allGood: All {{count}} rows are valid. Press Import to add them.
imp.hasErrors: {{count}} rows have errors. Fix them in the file and choose it again — nothing is added while any row has an error.
imp.duplicateExisting: Serial already exists — will still be added (warning only).
imp.duplicateFile: Same serial as row {{row}} in this file — will still be added (warning only).

issue.parent_not_found: {{column}}: parent "{{value}}" not found (in the system or in this file).
issue.parent_ambiguous: {{column}}: "{{value}}" matches {{count}} equipment — also fill in Parent part number, or leave blank and attach later with Move.
issue.parent_cycle: {{column}}: parent loop in this file (equipment cannot be its own ancestor).
issue.location_follows_parent: {{column}}: a child follows its parent's location ({{value}}) — leave this blank.
issue.level_follows_parent: {{column}}: a child follows its parent's level ({{value}}) — leave this blank.
issue.type_follows_part_number: {{column}}: follows the part number ({{value}}) — leave this blank.

file.not_xlsx: Only Excel .xlsx files are accepted — use the template.
file.unreadable: Cannot read the file. Open it in Excel, save as .xlsx and try again.
file.empty: The file has no data rows (start right below the header row).
file.too_many_rows: The file has {{count}} rows — at most {{max}} per import. Split the file.
file.missing_columns: Missing required columns: {{columns}}. Do not rename the header row — download the template again.
file.sendFailed: Could not send the file. If you edited it after choosing it, choose it again; otherwise check your network connection.

tpl.generated: Generated {{time}}. Drop-down lists come from Configuration at this time — download again after an admin adds or hides values.
tpl.step1: Enter one equipment per row on sheet "{{sheet}}", starting at row 3. Row 1 is notes, row 2 is the header — do not rename or delete them.
tpl.step2: Columns marked * are required; other columns may be left blank.
tpl.step3: List columns: click the cell → pick from the drop-down arrow. Only values in the list are accepted (case-insensitive).
tpl.step4: Save as .xlsx → Equipment › Import Excel → choose the file. It is checked first; if any row has an error nothing is added. Up to {{max}} equipment per import.
tpl.pickMany: Pick from the list ({{count}} values — see sheet "{{sheet}}")
tpl.noValues: No values yet — leave blank, or ask an admin to add them in Configuration
tpl.errorList: Pick a value from the list. If a value is missing, ask an admin to add it in Configuration, then download the template again.
tpl.requiredUnlessParent: Required unless a parent is given (then leave blank)
tpl.parentSerial: Serial of the parent: existing equipment, or another row in this file (row order does not matter). Leave blank if there is no parent
tpl.parentPart: Only needed when the parent serial is used by more than one equipment
tpl.locationParent: leave blank when a parent is given: location follows the parent
tpl.levelParent: leave blank when a parent is given: level follows the parent
tpl.typeFromPart: leave blank when Part number is given: Type follows the part number (Configuration › Part Number)
tpl.stepParent: Child equipment: fill in Parent serial number (existing equipment, or another row in this file). Leave Location blank — a child is always at its parent's location.

cal.needsPartNumber: This equipment has no part number — set one before tracking its calibration.
cal.needsSetup: Not tracked: this part number is not in Configuration › Calibration › Setup.
cal.statusFromEquipment: Equipment status — change it in Equipment.

gimp.title: Import golden samples from Excel
gimp.step1Desc: The template has drop-down lists for Location and Status, taken from Configuration at download time. Its first row says what each column accepts. Download it again after Configuration changes.

tpl.step1: Enter one golden sample per row on sheet "{{sheet}}", starting at row 3. Row 1 is notes, row 2 is the header — do not rename or delete them.
tpl.step4: Save as .xlsx → Golden › Import Excel → choose the file. It is checked first; if any row has an error nothing is added. Up to {{max}} golden samples per import.

cfg.activeHint: Hidden values stay on existing records but cannot be chosen for new data.
cfg.partTypeHint: Every equipment with this part number gets this Type — changing it updates all of them.
cfg.warningHint: Equipment within this many days of the due date shows as "Due soon".
cfg.colorHint: Used for this status on every page and on the Dashboard. Green = normal / passed · Yellow = needs attention · Red = failed / act now · Blue = waiting / info · Gray = inactive / neutral.
cfg.optionsStale: The change was saved, but the dropdown lists could not be refreshed. Reload the page so forms use the new lists.
cfg.calibrationPartHint: Only part numbers used by equipment in Equipment and not set up yet. Their equipment joins the calibration dashboard automatically.
cfg.partNumberFixed: The part number cannot be changed — delete this setup and add a new one.
cfg.calibrationDeleteWarning: Delete the setup for {{name}}? Its equipment leaves the calibration dashboard (history is kept).

usr.emailLocked: Email is the sign-in of this Supabase account and cannot be changed here.

usr.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. The user must change it at first sign-in.
usr.approveDesc: Approve {{name}} ({{username}}) and choose a role group.
usr.rejectDesc: Reject the account request of {{name}}? They will not be able to sign in.
usr.resetDesc: Set a new password for {{name}}. They must change it at next sign-in, and all their sessions end.
usr.disableDesc: Disable {{name}}? They cannot sign in until enabled again. Accounts are never deleted.
